title: finding(components): `action:icon` never consumes `autoTrigger` — a `?runAction=` deep link to an icon-rendered toolbar action is armed, consumed, and does nothing (the #4162 signature on a third renderer)
body:
Filing-gate category ①: product defect with a named landing site and a reproduction. Reader: the triage seat (route and grade), then a `domain:ui` execution seat; landing site `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx`. Dedupe: this is the #4162 signature on a third renderer; objectui#4162 (`action:menu`) and objectui#4191 (`visible` precedence) are the siblings, and neither covers `action:icon`.

## What is wrong

`action:bar` hands an inline member authored with `component: 'action:icon'` the host-composed `autoTrigger` flag, and `action:icon` never reads it. So a deep link (`?runAction=<name>`) that `ObjectView` arms and **consumes** for a `list_toolbar` action rendered as an icon does nothing: no run, no notice. `action:button` and `action:menu` both run it, and after PR objectui#10272 both refuse it with a notice when `visible` hides it.

## Reproduction

Measured by objectui#4191's dev on branch `claude/issue-4191-autotrigger-honours-visible` (head `23cbae7`), a probe not committed: the same action with `autoTrigger: true` as an inline `action:icon` member ⇒ `icon_execute=0`; as `action:button` (control) ⇒ `button_execute_control=1`. ⚠️ Relayed from that dev's report, not re-run by the filing seat; whoever takes this re-measures on `main` after PR objectui#10272 lands.

## Fix direction (precedent, not a ruling)

Route `action:icon` through the shared `useAutoTriggerOnce(action, isVisible, run)` in `auto-trigger.ts`, as PR objectui#10272 does for the other two renderers, so all three share one trigger + visibility + notice path.

## Dedupe words

`action:icon autoTrigger` · `icon deep link runAction` · `autoTrigger inline icon member` · `#4162 third renderer`
